brand_essence_summary: Visual identity compiled from 5 references in 'COYOTE BURGUER'. Defined by artisanal desert folk & handcrafted street-food identity, tactile_organic surfaces (grain 28.49), and a balanced CIELAB palette (40.72% earth tones).

background_primary.name: Primary Canvas
background_primary.role: Main page background and negative space

background_secondary.name: Contrast Band Canvas
background_secondary.role: High-contrast dark/inverted bands, footers, and feature callouts

surface_card.name: Elevated Surface
surface_card.role: Cards, menu tiles, and interactive containers

text_primary.name: Primary Ink
text_primary.role: Headings, body copy, and crisp borders

accent_primary.name: Hero Accent
accent_primary.role: Primary CTAs, key brand marks, and focal highlights

accent_secondary.name: Supporting Accent
accent_secondary.role: Badges, secondary tags, stickers, and hover states

color_system.color_harmony_notes: Mathematically derived via CIELAB K-Means across 5 pins. Overall temperature is balanced with dark_moody polarity, earth-tone share 40.72%, and texture grain score 28.49.
forbidden_colors: Unrelated neon cyan (#00FFFF) unless explicitly in accent tokens

display_heading.styling_notes: Carved organic display serif with warm earthen authority and hand-printed character.

section_heading.styling_notes: Stamped woodblock-style condensed headers for sections, menu categories, and callouts.

body_copy.styling_notes: Warm humanoid geometric sans that remains crisp over stone, clay, and cream surfaces.

monospace_accent.styling_notes: Craft batch stamps, coordinates, prices, and desert outpost tags.

frontend_ui_rules.aesthetic_archetype: Artisanal Desert Folk & Handcrafted Street-Food Identity
frontend_ui_rules.layout_grid_style: Asymmetric editorial bento grid with bold bordered containers and tactile surface contrast.
texture_and_effects: Raw mineral sandstone & unglazed clay texture (grain score 28.49)
Hand-painted terracotta (#B13B29) and cobalt (#6896D8) block-print motifs
Linocut / screenprint edge irregularity and stamped badges

component_guidelines.buttons: Solid #B13B29 fill with #FAF8F5 bold uppercase label, 2px solid #B13B29, 4px 4px 0px #14110F; shift -2px/-2px on hover.
component_guidelines.cards: Use #262320 surface with 2px solid #B13B29, radius 6px, and 4px 4px 0px #14110F.
component_guidelines.navigation: Sticky top bar on #332929 with bottom 2px solid #B13B29, high-contrast brand mark on left and single bold CTA on right.
component_guidelines.hero_section: Split or full-bleed showcase pairing display font (Fraunces) with high-res reference imagery and stamp badge.
component_guidelines.badges: Pill (9999px) or sharp stamp tags in #6896D8 with #141210 monospace text (Space Mono).

anti_patterns: Do NOT use glossy corporate SaaS gradients, neon purple/cyan, or glassmorphism
Do NOT use sterile pure #FFFFFF backgrounds â€” always use warm sandstone/adobe cream or deep earth charcoal
Do NOT use generic stock-photo icons; use bold folk-art silhouettes and stamp borders

generative_ai_prompts.global_style_suffix: anchored in #332929 earth, #B13B29 burnt terracotta, and #6896D8 cobalt slate, tactile sandstone grain, natural warm studio lighting
